nom: Peter Thomas Roth Pumpkin Enzyme Mask Enzymatic Dermal Resurfacer

segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers report a wide range of reactions, from painful burning, redness, and breakouts to a tolerable tingle when the time is shortened to two-to-five minutes; several reviewers explicitly advise against it for very sensitive or reactive skin.
segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin report it helps clear easily clogged pores and reduce blackheads without making their oiliness worse.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin report effective exfoliation of flaky patches, though a few note the mask itself can leave skin feeling dry right after rinsing.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers, including one managing redness from seborrheic dermatitis, report smoother texture and reduced acne scarring without new irritation.
segments.mature: A few reviewers in their late 40s and 50s report smoother texture, softened fine lines, and less visible sun damage after weeks of regular use.

concerns.blemishes: Many reviewers report reduced acne, blackheads, and clogged pores, including hormonal and cystic breakouts, though a couple describe the mask causing a breakout or feeling too rough on their skin.
concerns.redness: Reviews are split: most describe brief redness or stinging that fades within minutes, but a few report a rash, painful burning, or lasting irritation, especially on already-sensitive or dry skin.
concerns.spots: Reviewers report faded acne scars, sun damage, and hyperpigmentation with continued use over several weeks to months.
concerns.dehydration: The mask is generally described as leaving skin soft rather than dry, though a few reviewers note some dryness or tightness right after rinsing it off.
concerns.aging: A few reviewers mention smoother texture and softened fine lines after consistent use, secondary to the mask's main exfoliating and acne effects.

aspects.libelle: Strong tingling or burning sensation on application
Gritty texture effectively exfoliates dead skin
Texture too rough or grainy for some, hard to rinse off
Long-lasting, a little goes a long way

extraits.texte: THIS PRODUCT LEFT ME WITH A RASH ON MY LEFT CHEEK. I TRIED THIS ONE NIGHT AND THE NEXT DAY I WOKE UP WITH RED BUMPS, NOT ACNE, ALL OVER THE LEFT SIDE OF MY FACE

This is way overpriced for the product you get. I don't understand how everyone else is getting results, because the only thing this does for me is irritate my skin. I used it twice a week for a month and there were absolutely no differences between before and after. If anything, my skin became more sensitive. Wouldn't recommend. The Andalou Naturals pumpkin honey glycolic mask is way cheaper and does a way better job.

extraits.titre: Not for the sensitive and dried out skin....
extraits.texte: I am trying out PRT for the first time. This is my second mask that I have used from the mask-a-holic gift box. I made sure to clean my skin very gently due to not using it during my routine. I have no problems with the smell, enjoyed the initial placement onto my face. But soon after my face specifically where I have problems with dryness and irritations flared up. It was painful during the portion I was rubbing the product in and when waiting for the time duration. It seemed to have subsided a bit over time but the initial pain was awful. I could see the redness through the mask. After I rinsed off the mask I didn't see any difference. Except, more redness and dryness. Would recommend for someone else's skin but not mine...way too harsh and didn't do anything.

I got this in a sample pack of other PTR masks, and this was the first I tried. I have combination-ish skin, with dry patches on my nose and forehead and seborrheic dermatitis on my cheeks, giving it a red, almost rosacea-like quality. I was initially nervous that it would inflame my redness. When I put it on, it smelled amazing, right off the bat. Not a cloying sweetness, but like a legit pumpkin pie. There was a slight warm tingle at first, but it went away fairly quickly. I left it on for around 7 minutes. It was an amaaaazing exfoliator, I no longer have the dry, flakiness on my nose (which seemed like it would never go away), my skin is smooth and soft. It didn't irritate my sensitive skin at all, and that's a miracle in and of itself! I will be purchasing this in the larger size whenever I've finished my sample-- a little does go a long way!

extraits.titre: Professional Facial Grade with significant outcome
extraits.texte: I am a 50-year-old female with historical sun damage, ACNE scars and fine lines. I also have combination skin. I found this mask very effective to even out my skin tone - minimize sun damage and old ACNE scars and pretty much smooth my skin (no more fine lines) only after about 2 months of use. I have to mention though, this product is very "professional grade" with potent ingredients. I can feel my face tingle (meaning that the enzyme is doing its work). So please allergy check before you use it on your entire face. Reserve sufficient time when you incorporate this product in your skincare regimen. You need to put this product on your face and wait a few minutes the enzyme could do its work and then gently massage your face for a couple of minutes to let the exfoliator remove dead skin cells. This is in general a very effective product.

So I got this when I got the mini mask try it kit and this is my absolute favorite one!! I have super oily skin and constant blackhead and usually always have 2 or 3 full blown pimples as any given time. I used this mask twice in one week and I dare say my skin was clear!!?? I was AMAZED at how well it works. Also your face will be as soft as a baby butt after using this no joke. Currently the full size is sold out but I keep checking because there is no way I can ever live my life without this ever again. TOTAL game changer!!!

I've used this mask on and off for a few years (only because it's expensive to repurchase every time I need a new one), but I loveeee it! My acne vanishes within a week of using it, and my skin always looks healthier and more vibrant. Disclaimer: I wouldn't recommend it for super sensitive skin types. Instructions say to leave it on for about 10 minutes, and it literally makes your face SIZZLE the whole time
